subject: Fennick Electrical: overdue invoices
body:
Hello Fennick Electrical accounts team,

I hope you are well. Our records show these invoices from you as overdue:

- INV-08002, due 2026-08-09, 4514.50 EUR
- INV-08001, due 2026-09-07, 1703.76 EUR
- INV-08003, due 2026-10-02, 7602.07 EUR

Together they come to 13820.33 EUR. Could you confirm this balance on your side, so we can settle it in our next payment run?

Thank you, and best regards,
Ines, Accounts Payable, Quellbrook Instruments
